### **INSURANCE REGULATORY AND DEVELOPMENT AU'l"HORITY (HEALTH INSURANCE) (FIRST AMENDMENT) REGULATIONS, 2014** 

> **F. No. IRDA/Reg/7/90/2014.-ln** exercise of the po\vers conferred under Section 114A of the Insurance Act 1938 and Section 14 read with section 26 of the IRDA Act 1999 and in consultation with the Insurance Advisory Committee, the Authority hereby makes the follov,ing regulations, namely:- 

**1. Short title and commencement.**

### **Reg 5 (g)** is **substituted by the following:** 

#### **Free Look Period** 

~, All new individual health insurance policies except those with tenure of less than a year shaJI have a free look period. The free look period shall be applicable at the inception of the policy and: 

- 

- l. The insured Yi ill be alloY.ed a period of at least 15 days from the date of receipt of the policy 10 review the terms and conditions of the policy and to return the same if not acceptable 

2. If the insured has not made any claim during the free look period, the insured shall be entitled to- 

   - a. A refund of in the premium paid less any expenses curred by the insurer on medical 

   - examination of the insured and persons the stamp duty charges or: 

   - b. ,vhere the risk has already commenced and the option of return of the policy is exercised the li by po cyholder. a deduction towards the proportionate risk premium 

   - for period on cover or; 

   - of 

   - c. Where only a pan the risk has commenced, such proportionate risk premium commensurate with the risk covered during such period. 

   - d. ln respect of unit linked policy. 1n addition to the above deductions, the insurer shall also be entitled to repurchase the unit at the price of the units as on the date of the return of the policy. 

**Reg S** (i)(iii) is **substituted** by **the following** 

### **Cumulative bonus**
